purpose: Observe bounded Jet 3 catalog-name key contributions for every defined CP1252 byte above 0x7E while keeping Unicode boundary controls outside the physical catalog decoder.

preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0087 records the single-leaf catalog ParentId/Name key grammar, exact primary weights for the ASCII context alphabet used here, an observed 32-row leaf, and empty first-create page framing. EXP-0097 records that the first extended-name run completed every DAO attempt and exact metadata read, but its analyzer returned no_outcome because it tried to decode the metadata-only control arm as a catalog-key observation. The 41 defined-byte arms and all their names are unchanged. EXP-0097 also exposed mojibake in the outer transport copy, while the child result consumed by the analyzer remained exact UTF-8; the shared transport now reads every development JSON document with explicit UTF-8.
preregistration.authorization: This successor preregistration does not authorize acquisition. The EXP-0097 post-mutation run consumed the prior decision. One local-VM run is allowed only after exact final pins are independently reviewed, committed, and merged and the user makes a new explicit run decision.
preregistration.attempt_policy: Dispatch at most one three-replica run after renewed explicit authorization. Once the first DAO CreateDatabase mutation begins, any failure is a scientific result and must not be retried without another explicit human decision. Only an exception thrown directly by the name-bearing CreateTableDef or TableDefs.Append call is normalized as that name's rejection and allows the bounded arm to continue. Open, field creation/append, close, metadata, and cleanup failures stop the replica.

execution.environment: The private local Windows development VM documented in docs/LOCAL_WINDOWS_VM.md, using x86 Windows PowerShell and a ready DAO.DBEngine.36 provider.
execution.defined_domain: All 123 byte values in the strict Python cp1252/Unicode repertoire for 0x80-0xFF: every value except 0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90, and 0x9D. The producer manually excludes those five slots before using .NET decoding; this plan does not claim that .NET itself rejects or leaves those slots undefined.
execution.batching: The ordered defined-byte sequence is partitioned into the same 41 consecutive batches of exactly three used by EXP-0096. Each batch starts from a byte-identical copy of that replica's fresh empty database and appends one ASCII canary plus six uniquely tagged forms per byte: left, interior, and right singleton positions; a repeated pair; and both orders with the next defined byte, wrapping 0xFF to 0x80. Thus each batch attempts exactly 19 one-Long-field tables and never uses an undefined byte as a neighbor.
execution.metadata_controls: A separate fresh-empty controls arm attempts one ASCII canary followed by names containing U+007F and U+0081, U+008D, U+008F, U+0090, and U+009D. Because COM receives Unicode BSTR names, these are Unicode boundary/control-code probes, not CP1252-byte mappings. The controls arm is retained and identity-checked, and its exact UTF-16LE intended names, DAO operation/failure_operation outcomes, and exact post-close TableDefs metadata are validated. It is never passed to the catalog decoder. An accepted control means only that the exact BSTR append completed and the exact name appeared in post-close metadata; it makes no physical-key, CP1252 mapping, or collation claim.
execution.isolation: Each replica creates and closes one fresh dbVersion30 CP1252 database. It copies and identity-checks one arm at a time from the retained empty image, closes the database after every table append, and closes it before checkpoint capture. No rows or indexes are added.
execution.checkpoints: Retain empty, b00 through b40, and controls in that exact order per replica: 43 databases per replica and 129 for a passing run.
execution.capture: Record exact UTF-16LE name identity, intended defined bytes, every per-name created/error outcome and normalized create_tabledef or tabledefs_append failure operation, arm-before identity, closed-file SHA-256 and size before and after bounded read-only DAO metadata access, and the bounded sequential DAO table/field/index inventory, including actual system indexes and exact one-field/no-index user schemas. Record mutation state and exact append/cleanup phase plus at most the active next checkpoint as recovery. A capture_empty failure retains empty as the expected recovery or removes a partial root artifact; a cleanup failure after a checkpoint is recorded with that checkpoint in the prefix and never duplicates it as recovery. Working MDBs stay below a non-published subdirectory. The analyzer independently regenerates the domain, batches, neighbors, names, and artifact inventory; validates every attempt, inventory, unchanged checkpoint, and retained failed prefix; decodes and correlates only b00 through b40; and preserves complete key bytes, primary sections, secondary nibbles, object IDs, and row locators per replica. Replica equality is exact for question-bearing attempts, created/rejected state, normalized operation, isolated primary bytes, secondary nibbles, and pair conclusions, but excludes incidental object IDs and row locators.
execution.transport_contract: Every replica carries a fixed sentinel containing, in order, every defined CP1252 character from the experiment followed by U+007F, U+0081, U+008D, U+008F, U+0090, and U+009D, as both text and exact UTF-16LE hex. The analyzer requires exact code-point identity in the child job result and the top-level transport copy. Static contract tests require BOMless UTF-8 writers, explicit UTF-8 reads, and unchanged replica pass-through through dispatch-result.json to result.json. The repository has no Windows PowerShell runtime, so exact execution of both serialization hops is validated only by the eventual preregistered acquisition, not by the pre-merge Linux test.

questions.coverage: For every exact defined CP1252 byte above 0x7E and each of its six forms, did DAO accept or reject the table name; and what exact BSTR/metadata outcome occurred for each metadata-only control?
questions.singleton_positions: For each accepted defined byte, what exact primary contribution and secondary nibbles occur in the left, interior, and right singleton contexts, and are those observations position-independent?
questions.pair_composition: For each accepted repeated form, does its exact primary contribution and secondary-nibble sequence equal two ordered singleton contributions?
questions.secondary_order: For each accepted neighbor pair in both orders, do its exact primary contribution and secondary-nibble sequence equal the corresponding ordered singleton observations, including expansions?
questions.replication: Do all three replicas agree exactly on the question-bearing attempts, operations, primary/secondary observations, pair conclusions, and metadata-control outcomes while permitting incidental object IDs and row locators to differ?

decision_rule.accepted: All final pins match; three replicas complete the exact 43-checkpoint inventory once; every arm starts byte-identical to its retained empty image; metadata access does not change bytes; every attempt and bounded sequential DAO table/field/index shape matches the regenerated inventory; every created name in b00 through b40 correlates to exactly one completely decoded catalog key; all 123 defined-byte observations and seven metadata controls are retained; the transport sentinel remains exact; and the exact question-bearing observations agree across replicas. Stable exact name-bearing DAO rejection, expansions, position dependence, non-additivity, contrary pair order, differing object IDs, or differing row locators are answered observations, not validation failures.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Any post-mutation producer failure, including capture or cleanup failure, incomplete arm, changed metadata identity, DAO/attempt/catalog disagreement, retained-prefix key decode or correlation failure in b00 through b40, loss of the single-leaf bounded grammar, transport-sentinel mismatch, or question-bearing replica disagreement including normalized failure-operation disagreement is recorded as no_outcome. The metadata-only controls cannot cause a catalog decode or correlation no_outcome because they are never decoded.
decision_rule.rejected: A pre-mutation plan, pin, provider, or infrastructure failure; malformed or duplicate JSON; inconsistent mutation/phase/checkpoint/recovery state; unexpected, reordered, duplicate, missing, symlinked, oversized, or extra artifact; bound violation; or analyzer contract defect rejects validation without a scientific outcome.
decision_rule.retry: There is no automatic retry after the first DAO mutation.

retention.publish: environment.json, result.json, the bounded job result, up to 129 exact expected-name MDBs including at most one active-next-checkpoint recovery artifact per failed replica (exactly 129 for a passing job), and the deterministic analyzer report.
retention.repository: Never commit MDB bytes or provider binaries. Record a validated report identity and conclusion once as a later additive EXP outcome.

publication.canonical_result: One validated deterministic JSON report and one later additive EXP outcome.

exclusions: CP1252 bytes 0x00-0x7E except the exact ASCII contexts; U+007F and the five undefined-slot Unicode values are metadata-only controls
any claimed CP1252 mapping, physical catalog key, or collation fact for U+007F, U+0081, U+008D, U+008F, U+0090, or U+009D
names with more than two non-ASCII characters, other positions or contexts, locale/code-page variants, case folding, or general collation semantics
catalog trees beyond the recorded single-leaf grammar, more than 19 user tables per defined arm, rows, indexes, relationships, long field names, continuation pages, or map spill
public creation API, filesystem publication, writer correctness, hosted differential #102, compatibility claims, and support-matrix movement
